requirements.description: Home page: central prompt input, ≥4 example prompt cards, and a "我的项目" grid (empty state OK until projects exist).
Submitting a prompt creates a `project` + `run` for the current `deviceId` and opens the workbench route.

Server SSE stream emits ordered `agent_events` for Planner (mini-PRD + AC-1..n), Architect (file/component/data plan), and Engineer (structured `files[]`). Events persist to D1/`agent_events` with monotonic `seq`.
Workbench left rail shows an Agent timeline (Planner / Architect / Engineer cards: status, elapsed time, expandable payload). Chinese copy.

Workbench right pane has 预览 and 代码 tabs. Preview bundles generated multi-file React+TS via self-hosted `esbuild-wasm` into a sandboxed iframe (`sandbox="allow-scripts"` only — no `allow-same-origin`). Code tab shows a file tree + source viewer.
Vendor/self-host all preview runtime assets from our origin (esbuild.wasm, whitelisted ESM deps, Tailwind browser build). Zero runtime dependency on external CDNs.
On successful Engineer completion, persist a `versions` row (`files` JSON, `acceptance` JSON, `summary`) and set `projects.current_version_id`. Messages (user + agent summaries) are stored.
Model routing: Flash-class for Planner/Architect; Pro-class for Engineer (exact model ids configurable). Structured output via Gemini `responseSchema` with one automatic retry on parse failure.
Interrupt handling: if SSE disconnects mid-run, mark run `interrupted` and surface a Chinese "继续" affordance (documented known limitation).
E2E (`LLM_PROVIDER=mock`): core journey generate → preview renders expected mock content; persistence journey refresh → project still listed.

qualityWaivers.reason: Create project+run and route navigation are functional/API concerns; post-submit workbench quality is judged under REQ-4/REQ-5 (REF-1 timeline + preview).
SSE agent_events are a server/data contract; quality is enforced by ordered timeline UI judges on REQ-4/REF-1 plus unit seq checks — no separate visual surface for raw events.
Self-host/vendor assets are infrastructure; RL-2 CDN pitfalls + judge RB-33 cover the quality risk without a dedicated aesthetic judge.
Version/message persistence has no distinct visual chrome in F2 beyond the project list already judged under REQ-1/REQ-10.
Model routing and responseSchema retry are server-only; user-visible quality is covered by timeline/preview judges on the mock journey.
REQ-10 is the e2e/verify acceptance gate itself; visual quality of those journeys is judged via REQ-1/REQ-4/REQ-5 anchors.
